home.heroHeadline: We Find What Actually Moves the Needle.
home.heroSubheadline: Relevate works inside your team, not just sends a monthly report. Strategy, execution, and evaluation move together as your business grows.
home.ctaBannerHeadline: Ready to Turn Data Into Growth?
home.whyTitle: Not an agency that lets go.
home.whyLead: We measure success by the decisions you can make, not by the thickness of our report.
home.why1Body: You know who is doing the work and who to ask.
home.why2Body: Written for decisions, not to impress fellow practitioners.
home.why3Body: Each suggestion carries its data basis and expected impact.
home.why4Body: Reports arrive without chasing, and every number traces back to its source.
home.servicesLead: Not a long list that never gets executed.
home.svc1Body: Making sure every page can be crawled, loads fast, and is understood by search engines and AI models alike.
home.svc2Body: Content that shows real experience, with authors and sources readers and machines can check.
home.svc3Body: Getting your brand cited by AI engines: ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google search summaries.
home.svc4Body: A plan measured in years, not a three month campaign. Priorities chosen for impact and durability.
home.step1Body: Start with the revenue model, business goals, constraints, and opportunities.
home.step2Body: Priorities chosen by impact and effort, not by trend.
home.step3Body: Technical and content optimization as planned, while adapting to change.
home.step4Body: We review performance together with you, with accurate conclusions.
home.step5Body: Once the pattern is visible, long term opportunities open up.
home.approachNoteTitle: That is why we are a **companion**.
home.approachNoteBody: Working with us means gaining a long term partner who is always ready to help.
home.ctaHeadline: Let us start with a conversation.
home.ctaBody: Tell us about your business and what is holding it back. We will show you the most sensible first step.
